doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Correction of Public Tender Offer Commencement Announcement in Connection with Submission of Corrected Public Tender Offer Filing by Gerbera holdings Corporation
doc_title_jp: （訂正）Gerbera holdings株式会社による公開買付届出書の訂正届出書の提出に伴う公開買付開始公告の訂正に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 公正取引委員会から排除措置命令不実施通知及び禁止期間短縮通知を受領

summary_en: Gerbera holdings corrects its tender offer filing for METALART following receipt of FTC non-objection notice and expedited prohibition-period shortening notice dated 2 June 2026. Correction relates to withdrawal conditions under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Enforcement Regulation Article 14; tender price, share count, and acquisition parameters remain unchanged.
summary_jp: ゲルベラホールディングスがメタルアート普通株式の公開買付けに係る届出書を訂正。6月2日付公正取引委員会の排除措置命令不実施通知及び禁止期間短縮通知受領に伴う修正。買付価格・株数等の買付条件は変更なし。

summary_en: Correction to 14 May 2026 support opinion on Gerbera Holdings' tender offer for MetalArt. Change in item ⑩: reference to 'bilateral contract' (二者間契約書) amended to 'shareholder agreement' (株主間契約). Tender price, share count, and acquisition terms unchanged from original filing.

doc_title_en: Notice of Commencement of Tender Offer for Common Shares of MetalArt Corporation (Code: 5644) by Gerbera holdings Corporation
summary_en: ¥7,600/share tender offer by Gerbera holdings for 1,825,640 MetalArt shares (min. 867,000 / 30.29% S/O). Period May 15 – Jun 25, 2026 (30 business days). Offeror to acquire complete control (完全子会社化). Target board recommends acceptance. Settlement Jul 2, 2026.
summary_jp: Gerbera holdings によるメタルアート公開買付け：¥7,600/株、1,825,640株（下限867,000株/30.29%）。2026年5月15日～6月25日（30営業日）。完全子会社化目的。取締役会賛同・応募推奨。決済7月2日。
